name: plan
description: Create or replace a plan for a complex task. Use `plan_update` for status changes and call `plan` again only when the task shape changes. Skip simple one-step work.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for later plan operations in this turn:
- Keep step statuses current with `plan_update`; replace the plan only when the task shape changes.
- Set `delegate` true for substantive bounded work. Keep trivial work, tightly coupled edits, and final review in the parent.
- Delegated steps run serially with `task` unless independent steps use `parallelizable` with concurrent `task_spawn`.
- Mark `parallelizable` only when the step has no dependency on the previous step.
- Use the primary tool name in `tool`, or `none` when no tool is needed.

action.description: What to do in this step (e.g. 'read src/main.rs' or 'apply the fix').

reason.description: Why this step is needed and what it should achieve.

tool.description: Primary tool for this step (e.g. 'read_file' or 'apply_patch'); use 'none' if no tool is needed.

parallelizable.description: Whether this delegated step can run with the previous step because no dependency exists. Default false.

delegate.description: Whether a subagent should do this step. Use true for substantive bounded work; keep trivial or tightly coupled work and final review in the parent.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to accomplish the task.

summary.description: Brief one-line summary of the overall plan.
